title: ID0378480-DC/Si-D/FI[2KqqUd] - Fastshutdown failed in DC3/4
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Fastshutdown test for dc 3 and 4 failed due to broken kf214. Ecog was powered on but the power LED was very dim.
Root cause:
sicharge-cp-ecog-secc-adapter.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
sicharge-cp-ecog-secc-adapter.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
sicharge-cp-ecog-secc-adapter.service: Service RestartSec=1s expired, scheduling restart.
Solution:
Replace KF214
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
NOTE TO QM: Information in timeline (RC to provide missing information)
Dispenser SN:
F2S3400184
